steps_h2: How to Make a Retargeting Video Ad in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Turn one source photo into a focused second look, then add campaign details after download.

steps.d: Add a clear source photo with the full product visible. Keep the detail to revisit in frame.
Choose one focused second look, such as a seam, pocket or use moment. Keep the product as the subject.
Download the result, then add your confirmed offer or link in your editor. Set audience and frequency in your ad platform.

faq.q: What is a retargeting video ad?
faq.a: It is a new product creative for shoppers who have already seen an item. Set the audience, offer and frequency in your ad platform.

faq.q: Does AIVideosUGC choose my retargeting audience?
faq.a: No. Choose visitors, cart users, exclusions, budget and frequency in your ad platform.

faq.q: Can the video know that someone viewed a product or left a cart?
faq.a: No. The clip does not receive a viewer history. Keep browsing or cart claims out of the scene unless your ad platform supplies them.
Upload one clear photo that shows the complete product and the detail you want shoppers to revisit.

faq.q: What result does this template show?
faq.a: It shows one focused product moment, such as a feature close-up, routine use or a return-to-cart reminder.

faq.q: Which length or format should I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Use 1:1 for feed or 9:16 for Reels when those formats match your campaign.

faq.q: Can I change details after download?
faq.a: Yes. Add the confirmed price, offer, date or product link in your editor or ad platform after the scene is ready.

faq.q: Do I need a shoot day?
faq.a: No. Start with one product photo, choose a scene and review the generated result before posting.

faq.q: Where can I use the clip?
faq.a: Use it as creative in a retargeting campaign, feed post or Reels ad. Configure targeting and destination in the platform where you buy media.

faq.q: How much do the videos cost?
faq.a: A 6-, 10-, 15- or 30-second clip costs 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits, and you see the charge before you start.

faq.q: Can I test more than one second look?
faq.a: Yes. Create another scene from the source photo and compare the versions in your ad platform without reshooting.

visual.overview: A retargeting video puts the product back in a shopper's feed with one clear reason to return. Show it in a familiar routine or focus on a detail the buyer is still weighing, then add your offer and product link after download.

steps.sourceAlt: Dark navy over-ear headphones with padded ear cups on a pale background.
steps.sourceHint: Keep the complete headband and both ear cups in clear focus.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. An adult commuter wearing the over-ear headphones walks along a bright station platform and turns toward an arriving train, both ear cups visible. Soft daylight, candid phone-video look. Medium side-follow framing with one smooth handheld move. End side-on at the station with both ear cups visible. Sound: footsteps and low station ambience; no music.
